implementation.capture: Explicit keyboard/button intent only. Real getUserMedia,48kHz AudioWorklet mono20ms frames and camera VideoFrame callbacks; source sample/frame timestamps retained across gaps. A pending late permission grant is stopped after cancellation.
implementation.packet_io: HTTP lease scoped to browser owner, current actor and exact original Connection/negotiation. Capture is encoded through installed public codecs; typed SDK packets and source clocks retain their original sequence. No retry after uncertain send.
implementation.playback: Decoded borrowed frames are copied into owned48kHz WebAudio buffers or bounded retained VideoFrames, using one NTP presentation origin; missing/stale SR remains explicitly unsynchronized. Source changes close the original decoder/output resources.
implementation.lifecycle: Local tracks, requests, codecs, worklet, graph and retained frames retire on stop, hidden page, offline, actor/conversation switch, view loss, control binding changes and reconnect. Late original replies cannot become a replacement lease. A close must name its original lease; abandoned-open replies retire only that original.
implementation.ui: Explicit start microphone / start microphone and camera and stop-media controls; denied/pending/unsupported/offline states; stop local capture before resource-changing controls. No backend secret enters browser configuration.
